dogecoin.text: Anyone can copy an open-source project like Bitcoin and build on top of it. This is what projects like #Litecoin, #Dash, #Dogecoin, or #Ravencoin have done. They have used Bitcoin's code, modified it, and launched their own blockchains/coins. A nice and clean code fork.
